outline.subtitle: Part A: replica count from measured numbers with Erlang C, headroom for cold starts, autoscaling on the queue, and token-fair multi-tenant scheduling with quotas and cache isolation. Part B: quality incident triage by slice, rollback, and defending the design in review with numbers and their sources.
